portal_description:
Evolution is the GNOME mailer, calendar, contact manager and communications
tool.  The tools which make up Evolution are tightly integrated with one
another and act as a seamless personal information-management tool.

This update introduces Evolution 2.8 to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 4.

Evolution 2.8 applies several improvements over past releases, most notably
with the user interface of both Calendar and Mailer. In addition to this,
Evolution 2.8 also features improved Search functions, including a Quick
Search toolbar and a single interface to search for all mail.  

Evolution 2.8 also features:

* a new “Memos” component
* Calendar publishing support
* vertical view for wide-screen monitors
* CalDAV support
* Improved GroupWise support
* Improved Exchange support
* contact list support for LDAP address books
* in-line PGP signature/encryption support
* Thunderbird-compatible label storage on IMAP servers
* meeting delegation support

This new version is installed alongside Evolution 2.0.2, and is equivalent
to the version of Evolution in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 5.

Users are encouraged to upgrade to this new version by installing the
evolution28 package.
